scope: Read-only application-code and allocation audit; no USB, executable launch, hardware identity or RAM test. Does not approve a flashable image.

preferred_candidate.reason: Above every demonstrated original static object and below the previously proposed high banks; not a complete dynamic non-alias proof.
preferred_candidate.decision: Use [0x680,0x800) for the current 384-byte offline core, conditional on preserving original object and legal-index invariants; not a claim of exhaustive symbolic proof or hardware validation.
preferred_candidate.physical_capacity: Supported by common capabilities of every independently matched PIC18F/LF46/47J13/J53 candidate; exact silicon identity not read.

secondary_candidate.physical_capacity: Also supported across the matched family candidates, but not required for the selected 384-byte allocation.

scan.warning: Raw word search includes data and second words, deliberately conservative for absence. It does not resolve pointer dataflow or unknown bootloader code.

startup.fixed_single_byte_rom_copies: Other scalar ROM copies below max are not individually listed; the entire startup instruction stream is hashed.

generic_TBLPTR_RAM_reads.unclosed: TBLPTR low16 is copied to FSR1 and INDF1 is read. TBLPTR is also used as RAM-pointer scratch; it cannot be assumed bounded by ROM tables. Caller argument provenance remains to be closed.

stack.observed_convention: PUSH/TOSL/TOSH/TOSU indirect callbacks; no demonstrated initialized FSR software-frame stack. This is not a maximum hardware-stack-depth proof.

interrupt_FSRS_context.condition: Entry/exit save slots do not overlap candidates. Subordinate ISR dynamic aliases need the same full pointer-bound proof; do not infer no overlap merely from save slots.

normal_ring_bounds.bound: count==capacity rejects; write>=capacity wraps by subtractingcapacity; valid initialized producer/consumer invariants required

required_before_hardware_claim: Independent exact MCU or bounded family RAM map showing proposed interval is implemented general-purpose RAM, not peripheral/USB special memory.
Close the listed dynamic FSR high-byte sources and generic TBLPTR RAM-reader callers, including receive-length bounds, indirect callbacks, all ISR paths and startup-to-runtime lifecycle.

Relocated core must initialize every allocated byte after native startup, preserve BSR and pointer/context registers required by native helpers/interrupts, and not share buffers passed to unbounded 8-bit native copy helpers.

Actual-image emulation must instrument every RAM read/write to distinguish original/native accesses from new core accesses and include UI, camera, UART RX/TX, journal, sleep/wake and interrupt interleavings. Tests are bounded evidence, not full proof.

hardware_capability_reference.reference_conclusion: Strong common peripheral-map family evidence for PIC18F/LF47J13 or PIC18F/LF47J53 intended targets; exact silicon part unproven. Required RAM and erase geometry are shared by every local-header match including 46 variants.

do_not_relax: Do not claim absence of heap solely from direct-address scan; this audit found a static-object/callback architecture and no allocator or software-stack setup, not a mathematical absence proof.
Native helper pointer-width and ISR ABI must be preserved.
Final linked images require native/new RAM trace separation for changed paths.
Existing native shared fields, e.g. F IRQ-written FE, must not be restored blindly as scratch.
